decision.rationale:
[recovery-agent diagnosis via claude-fable-5-1+claude-opus-5[1m]] ROOT CAUSE: most likely a false positive of the density-homogeneity check on perfluorinated chemistry, not an unmixed melt. No lever in the contract changes the quantity the gate measures.

WHY THE AUTO-REMEDY NEVER RAN: the engine did not try melt_homogeneity and run out. It declined on sizing: recovery_log.jsonl auto_remedy_rejected melt_homogeneity, "ValueError: cannot size a continuation: the finding carries no extension_ns and there is no default (failing gates: ['density_homogeneity'])". remedy_counters.total=0.

EVIDENCE (attempts/equilibration/attempt-0001/raw/equilibration.json):
(1) density_homogeneity is the only failing binding gate: cv_signal 0.185 vs max 0.11; cv_mean 0.279, poisson_cv 0.208, 24.2 atoms/voxel, grid 5^3.
(2) Every indicator that would show a mixing defect passes. MSD/Ree^2=0.93 (chains' centres of mass moved about one R_ee), no kinetic trap. Torsion JS 0.00027 (stable). Rg CV 15%, P2 0.027. C(t) is 60% decayed with tau_relax 4.0 ns inside a 4.95 ns trajectory. Density drift 0.45% with n_eff 73, all energy components pass, T=700.02 K.
(3) Every other run with this checker has cv_signal 0.00-0.07: aPS_1/2/3, PLLA_1/2/3, sPVC_2/3, iPMMA_1, PEG cross-grades. The one other outlier is PTFE_noAI at 0.193, run on the identical cell (same emc_seed 909670995 and velocity_seed 930760043), which also stopped on this gate. The failure tracks the chemistry and reproduces, so retry or wait_and_retry would repeat it. Disk has 28 G free and there is no GPU-related cause.
(4) Mechanism: the shot-noise floor assumes voxel mass comes from independent atoms, with only a mass-dispersion correction (check_equilibration_comprehensive.py:870-874). That works for H-rich polymers, where H carries little mass. In PTFE, 76% of the mass is F bonded 1.35 A from C, so the real counting units are CF2 groups of 50 amu, about 8 per voxel. Their counting floor is 1/sqrt(8.07)=0.352. The measured cv_mean of 0.279 is below that floor (a liquid is sub-Poissonian), so the whole "signal" is consistent with counting noise the formula under-subtracts.

WHY NO REVISE_PLAN LEVER HELPS:
(a) nchain: the adaptive grid targets about 25 atoms/voxel (line 1176, clamp [3,10]). A bigger cell keeps the same atoms/voxel and the same under-subtracted floor. Only past the grid_n=10 clamp does occupancy rise. Estimated from 1/sqrt(n) scaling of the measured cv, clearing 0.11 needs about 60 atoms/voxel even at the atom-level floor, i.e. about 60k atoms (nchain ~200, 20x this 3k-atom cell). That is about 20x the atoms of a 4.76 h equilibration, far beyond the plan's total_gpu_hours estimate of 5.37. Ree > L (0.845, advisory self-image flag) is real but is not the failing gate.
(b) npt_continuation_ns: run_campaign.py:2701 would extend npt_melt_hold in place. But voxel counting noise does not fall with trajectory length, and every mixing indicator already passes. The expected result is a null re-fail, then another escalation, for several more GPU-hours (the 2 ns melt hold was part of a 4.76 h attempt).
(c) Seeds, dt, T and the force field do not touch the voxel counting statistics.

DECISION: equilibration has already used 4.76 GPU-h (01:52-06:38) of a 5.37 GPU-h plan estimate. No available action has a credible chance of passing this gate at a cost worth paying. Close the run.

Record for follow-up: the melt otherwise meets every thermo, chain and structural gate (rho=1.450 g/cm3 at 700 K). The fix belongs in the checker: a bonded-group compound-Poisson floor, or a correlation-aware noise estimate. After that, PTFE_noAI and PTFE_AI can be regraded without new simulation.

decision.rationale:
[recovery-agent diagnosis via claude-opus-5[1m]] ROOT CAUSE: the PTFE transition is intrinsically broad at this rate. Per-point noise is not the problem, so the rate lever that method_gap usually calls for is unlikely to help.

WHAT I READ (attempts/thermal/attempt-0001/raw/thermal.json):
- The hyperbola fit gives Tg 525 K and the bilinear alternative gives 452.6 K, a method gap of 72.4 K against a 20 K limit.
- The fitted transition width is transition_width_c_K = 248.2 K, with tg_uncertainty_K 66.8 and r^2 0.9889.
- The density curve bends smoothly over most of the 100-715 K window. There is no sharp kink for either model to find, which is why the two models disagree.
- Per-T sampling is not noisy. 29 of 31 temperatures PASS as stable, n_eff is mostly 18-402, slopes have valid signs and order, and all 82 plateau bins were used. The only unstable points are the top two (700 and 680 K, EXHAUSTED). Their densities are non-monotonic (1.500 at 700 K, then 1.450 at 680 K, then 1.495 at 660 K), and tg_melt_start_density_consistent is false.
- Halving tg_rate_K_per_ns doubles the steps per T. That shrinks the variance of each point, but it does not narrow a 248 K-wide curvature. Both fits would still be run on the same smoothly bending curve.

COST:
- The failing thermal sweep at 100 K/ns took 5.1 h (20:07 to 01:15).
- Lowering the rate carries EXTRA_INVALIDATION to cooling, so the 2.7 h cooldown (17:26 to 20:07) would re-run as well. Going to 50 K/ns costs about 10 h of sweep plus a cooling re-run, roughly 13-15 GPU-h. The plan's whole-run estimate is 5.37 GPU-h, and equilibration and cooling have already used well over that.
- No auto-remedy was tried: remedy_counters.total=0, and tg_breakpoint correctly declines method_gap.

GRADING TARGET: the plan's own dominant_uncertainty says PTFE's experimental Tg is ambiguous. The curated value is 160 K (gamma relaxation), against a relaxation near 400 K. Both fitted values (453 and 525 K) are far from 160 K, and the hyperbola value sits close to md_tg_ceiling_K 550. So even a narrower gap would give a number with no reliable reference to grade against.

WHY NOT THE OTHERS:
- retry: a pinned seed reproduces a deterministic result.
- wait_and_retry: there is no resource cause.
- revise_plan with a lower tg_rate: high cost for a low chance of closing a 72 K gap on a 248 K-wide transition.
- end_run: throws away the mechanical (bulk modulus) stage, which is still pending and can run on the accepted cooled glass.

recover.md section 4 names exactly this case ('TG_REVIEW method_gap on a broad transition') for accept_with_caveat. Tg is withheld: tg_reportable=false, and it must not be frozen into the cache. The 300 K density and K can still finish.

caveats.note: stage accepted so the run can finish; its gate verdict stands and the property is withheld from results and from the characterization cache
